target_definition: Original 0-6 rating distribution: equal weight per beer and per taster within beer; repeated presentations split that taster's weight. No taster z-normalization or relative ECDF.
grade_decision: Integer conditional median, lower action on ties; GBR uses the nearest integer to its fitted 0.5 quantile, half-integer ties down. Finally cap each child by its predicted parent for all methods.
primary_metric: Mean absolute error to individual raw ratings, averaged equally over beers and all 50 targets with the declared within-beer taster weights.
secondary_metrics: MAE/exact/within-one versus observed weighted panel median
selection: One global candidate by mean inner-OOF primary loss across all 50 targets. Ties within 1e-12 follow candidate order. No per-target outer-test selection.
imputation: Median fitted to unique training beers only, before expanding to rating records. Never fit on validation beers or on the rating-count-weighted duplicated feature matrix.
qualification: Inner-selected workflow primary OOF loss improves over training-only pooled median and the lower 95% paired style-stratified beer-bootstrap improvement bound is positive. This qualifies a raw-scale Q1 delivery, not external independent validation.
current_data_scope: 250 beers, 226 measured chemical/physical properties plus 5 derived fields = 231 supplied input fields; model excludes the same 7 unresolved aggregates as the current protocol.
